name: development-react
description: React framework topic plugin (foundation slice, #956). Composes ALONGSIDE development-javascript via /development:maintenance (a TOPIC plugin, like development-spring composes with development-java), triggered by the React marker — `react` in the runtime dependencies of any package.json — and only when javascript is also detected. On the maintenance side the gather (gather-react-findings.zsh) audits two WebUI quality gates, a11y and lighthouse_budget, and the dispatcher's executable plan-dispatch.zsh routes each tool's findings as one group to react-webui-quality-advisor (#1948), which applies an edit only where it is mechanical — a setup-file matcher import, a jq edit to lighthouserc.json — and escalates the rest, never running npm, a browser or Lighthouse; CI remediation reuses js-ci-fixer. Ships the /development-react:review topic panel (#959), which the /development:resolve-issue loop runs beside the JavaScript panel when detect-stack reports is_react: one react-idioms-reviewer under the react_idioms dimension — a Rules of Hooks violation is CRITICAL, server state fetched outside TanStack Query is WARNING, and a Vite SPA shape or component-structure deviation is SUGGESTION.
